name: mcp-org-service-miss
description: Catalog-miss variant (Task E2): the referenced org service (`billing-service`) is NOT in the mock catalog (which only has `employee-api`). Resolution status (resolved/ambiguous/unresolved) is platform-computed at read time, never authored by the agent — this only asserts the agent still declares an `org-service` kind dependency after checking the catalog, not that it invents the missing provider's exact name.

turns.prompt: Derive a new backend component named `invoicing-api` — a Go service that calls the org's existing billing-service (owned by another project) to fetch invoice line items. Check the org's published endpoints before declaring that dependency.
